final: SELECT AVG(avg_pic) AS avg_of_avg_pic, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(avg_ratio - all_avg) AS avg_excess_ratio FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT != 0 THEN 1.0 * HGB / HCT END) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID) CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(patient_ratio) AS all_avg FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT != 0 THEN 1.0 * HGB / HCT END) AS patient_ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING patient_ratio IS NOT NULL)) WHERE avg_ratio > all_avg AND avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND avg_pic IS NOT NULL
